title: Lead Intake Webhook Contract (FEAT-LIW Chunk A)
description: Generic tenant-landing webhook. Each tenant's landing page/form POSTs a free-form payload; Invekto maps tenant fields to canonical fields via tenant_landing_settings.landing_field_map, normalizes phone to E.164, checks consent, then UPSERTs a lead and (for fresh leads) enqueues the welcome flow.

endpoint.auth: X-Invekto-Api-Key header (per-tenant pre-shared key, 24h grace rotation)

source_slug.description: Lowercase slug describing the source surface (e.g. 'ireland-roadshow-lp'). Stored on lead.source_slug; previous value overwritten on re-submission.

required.X-Invekto-Api-Key: Per-tenant API key; rotatable with 24h grace on old key

fields.description: Free-form source fields. Keys are the tenant's own field names; values are resolved to canonical via landing_field_map.

submitted_at.description: Tenant-side submission timestamp (optional; server NOW() used if missing)

canonical_fields.description: landing_field_map resolves source keys -> these canonical field names.
canonical_fields.phone_country_hint: Optional map entry 'phone.country_hint' (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) gives libphonenumber a parse hint when the source value is in national format.

response_field_semantics.lead_id: Invekto-side lead row id (stable across subsequent submissions under merge-by-phone).
response_field_semantics.duplicate: true when an existing lead row matched within the tenant's dup window (merge applied, no welcome re-enqueue). false when fresh or outside window (re-engagement path).
response_field_semantics.welcome_flow_enqueued: true only when Hangfire accepted the welcome-flow job (duplicate=false AND a welcome slug resolved AND enqueue succeeded). Reflects scheduling, NOT message delivery — the worker dispatches asynchronously on the `automation` queue with its own retries. Chunk A wires the enqueue path; the worker-side dispatch implementation lands in Chunk B.

400_payload_empty.message: Istek govdesi bos veya eksik; fields alani zorunlu

500_field_map_malformed.message: Tenant alan eslemesi bozuk, yetkili ile iletisime gecin

response_warnings.description: Non-fatal side-effect failures surfaced on a 201 response in the `warnings` array. Primary outcome (lead creation/merge) still succeeded; the caller can log/monitor these codes for ops visibility without polling server logs.

codes.INV-JOB-001: Hangfire storage (or enqueue) rejected the welcome-flow job. Lead was created; the welcome message will not fire until the tenant retries or Hangfire storage recovers.
codes.INV-JOB-002: DI/configuration error prevented the welcome-flow job handler from resolving. Lead was created; infra fix required to resume welcome automation.

rate_limit.retry_after_header: seconds until oldest request ages out (clamped to [1, 60])
rate_limit.v2_note: Redis-backed distributed counter for multi-instance scale-out

welcome_flow_trigger.condition: duplicate=false AND (lead is freshly created OR exited dup window)
welcome_flow_trigger.slug_fallback: tenant_landing_settings.welcome_flow_slug -> 'welcome_default' (Backend always emits a non-empty slug on enqueue; 'welcome_default' is a platform contract that Automation must resolve or raise INV-AT-068 worker-side).
welcome_flow_trigger.enqueue_failure_behavior: lead is still created; `welcome_flow_enqueued` returns false AND the response `warnings` array carries the Hangfire infra code (INV-JOB-001 storage, INV-JOB-002 handler-unresolved) so the caller has an explicit signal without reading server logs.
welcome_flow_trigger.worker_side_defensive: TriggerWelcomeFlowJob guards against an empty slug (defensive; Backend never sends one) and emits INV-AT-068 if reached.
